title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

title.zh: 第一次读 SEED？从这里开始

summary.zh: 先用无 GPU 路径理解机制，再做缩小规模的方法验证；只有模型、数据、环境、超参数和 8×A800 80GB 训练条件都对齐时，才进入严格复现。
summary.en: Understand the mechanism without a GPU first, then run a reduced method check. Move to strict reproduction only when the model, data, environments, hyperparameters, and 8×A800 80GB setup are aligned.

key_idea.zh: 同一个最新策略既采集轨迹，也分析完整轨迹生成 hindsight skill；skill 只提供训练期稠密监督，推理时只保留更新后的策略。
key_idea.en: The latest policy both collects trajectories and analyzes completed trajectories into hindsight skills. Skills provide dense training-time supervision; inference keeps only the updated policy.

novice_note.zh: 建议先完成“理解机制”。如果没有多卡训练资源，方法验证仍然有价值，但结果必须标成 mechanism smoke test，不能与论文主表分数直接比较。
novice_note.en: Complete the mechanism track first. A method smoke test is still useful without multi-GPU resources, but its score is not directly comparable with the paper's main tables.

value.zh: Stage 1 hindsight-skill SFT + Stage 2 自进化 OPD/GRPO
value.en: Stage 1 hindsight-skill SFT + Stage 2 self-evolving OPD/GRPO

goal.zh: 能用自己的话解释 SEED 解决了什么监督缺口、两阶段如何连接，以及它为什么不等于外部记忆。
goal.en: Explain the supervision gap SEED addresses, how its two stages connect, and why it is not an external-memory method.

title.en: Read the problem before the equations

body.zh: 长程智能体通常只在整条轨迹结束后得到稀疏奖励；这个奖励无法指出中间哪次观察、动作或工具调用值得强化。
body.en: Long-horizon agents often receive sparse reward only after a trajectory ends, so the reward does not identify which intermediate observations, actions, or tool calls deserve credit.

done_when.zh: 你能区分 trajectory-level outcome 与 token-level learning signal。
done_when.en: You can distinguish a trajectory-level outcome from a token-level learning signal.

body.zh: 普通策略先采集完整轨迹，外部分析器把成功经验或失败规避规则写成自然语言 hindsight skill，再用这些轨迹—skill 对进行 SFT。
body.en: A normal policy collects completed trajectories. An external analyzer writes reusable or failure-avoidance hindsight skills, and the trajectory–skill pairs train the policy with SFT.

done_when.zh: 你的图包含轨迹、外部分析器、skill 标注和 SFT checkpoint。
done_when.en: Your diagram includes trajectories, the external analyzer, skill annotations, and the SFT checkpoint.

body.zh: 最新冻结策略同时负责 rollout 与轨迹分析；同一批已采样动作在普通上下文和 skill 增强上下文中重新打分，概率差形成 OPD 信号，并与 GRPO 联合优化。
body.en: The latest frozen policy performs rollouts and trajectory analysis. The same sampled actions are re-scored in ordinary and skill-augmented contexts; their probability shift forms the OPD signal optimized jointly with GRPO.

done_when.zh: 你能指出 actor、analyzer、旧策略、可训练策略和 OPD loss 的关系。
done_when.en: You can identify the actor, analyzer, old policy, trainable policy, and OPD loss.

body.zh: hindsight skill、分析器和 skill prompt 都是训练期工具；部署时只运行已经内化这些行为变化的策略。
body.en: Hindsight skills, the analyzer, and skill prompts are training-time tools. Deployment runs only the policy that internalized the behavioral change.

done_when.zh: 你不会把 SEED 描述成“推理时检索 skill bank”。
done_when.en: You would not describe SEED as retrieving a skill bank at inference time.

goal.zh: 验证“轨迹 → hindsight skill → token 级 OPD → 策略更新”的代码和数据链是否成立，不追求论文主表分数。
goal.en: Validate the trajectory → hindsight skill → token-level OPD → policy-update chain without claiming the paper's main-table scores.

body.zh: 新手优先从 ALFWorld 开始：官方仓库给出直接安装命令，论文也提供了详细训练动态。固定 split、reward、最大交互步数与评估指标。
body.en: Start with ALFWorld: the official repository provides direct setup commands and the paper reports detailed training dynamics. Pin the split, reward, maximum interaction steps, and metric.

done_when.zh: 实验清单中只有一个环境，并写明评估协议。
done_when.en: Your manifest contains one environment and an explicit evaluation protocol.

title.zh: 先跑通环境与普通策略
title.en: Run the environment and vanilla policy first

body.zh: 安装 veRL 与 ALFWorld，固定仓库 commit、Python/CUDA/依赖版本；先保存一条普通 rollout，确认 observation、action、reward 和 terminal outcome 完整。
body.en: Install veRL and ALFWorld; pin the repository commit, Python/CUDA, and dependencies. Save one vanilla rollout and inspect the observation, action, reward, and terminal outcome fields.

done_when.zh: 一条轨迹可重复执行并产生结构完整的记录。
done_when.en: One trajectory can be rerun and produces a structurally complete record.

body.zh: 用少量任务生成轨迹与 hindsight skill，检查成功轨迹是否提炼可复用流程、失败轨迹是否产生规避规则；缩小数据规模后只能验证机制。
body.en: Generate trajectories and hindsight skills from a small task subset. Check that successful trajectories yield reusable workflows and failed trajectories yield avoidance guidance. Reduced data validates mechanism only.

done_when.zh: 能追溯一条 SFT 样本从原始轨迹到 skill target。
done_when.en: You can trace one SFT sample from its raw trajectory to the skill target.

title.zh: 对照 GRPO 检查 Stage 2

body.zh: 至少同时记录普通 GRPO 与 SEED 的环境回报、OPD loss、episode length 和有效 token mask。先确认 OPD 分支产生非零、稳定的训练信号，再讨论性能。
body.en: Log environment return, OPD loss, episode length, and valid-token masks for both vanilla GRPO and SEED. Confirm that OPD produces a non-zero, stable signal before discussing performance.

done_when.zh: 你能展示同一批 sampled actions 在普通与 skill 上下文中的分数差。
done_when.en: You can show the score shift for the same sampled actions under ordinary and skill contexts.

goal.zh: 对齐论文版本、三种 backbone、数据规模、全部基线、超参数和 8×A800 80GB 计算条件，复核主表、训练动态与泛化结论。
goal.en: Align the paper version, three backbones, data scale, baselines, hyperparameters, and 8×A800 80GB compute to recheck the main tables, training dynamics, and generalization claims.

body.zh: 记录 arXiv v1、代码 commit、每个 Qwen checkpoint revision、tokenizer、chat template、CUDA 与依赖锁定文件。
body.en: Record arXiv v1, the code commit, every Qwen checkpoint revision, tokenizer, chat template, CUDA version, and dependency lock state.

done_when.zh: 他人能从 manifest 重建同一软件与模型版本。
done_when.en: Another researcher can reconstruct the same software and model revisions from your manifest.

source_label.zh: 论文 v1 与官方代码

title.zh: 对齐数据与 rollout 数量

body.zh: 每个 benchmark 的 SFT 使用 180 个任务、每任务 8 条 rollout；RL 数据分别为 ALFWorld 2,400、WebShop 2,400、Search 19,200。
body.en: For each benchmark, SFT uses 180 tasks with 8 rollouts per task. RL uses 2,400 ALFWorld, 2,400 WebShop, and 19,200 Search instances.

done_when.zh: 数据 manifest 的 split、样本数和预处理产物与论文表 3 一致。
done_when.en: The data manifest's splits, counts, and preprocessing outputs match Table 3.

title.zh: 锁定训练超参数与资源

body.zh: 使用 150 次策略更新、rollout group 8、学习率 1e-6、OPD 系数 0.01、KL 系数 0.01，并记录论文的 batch、prompt/response 长度和各环境最大交互步数。
body.en: Use 150 policy updates, rollout group 8, learning rate 1e-6, OPD coefficient 0.01, and KL coefficient 0.01; also record the paper's batches, prompt/response lengths, and environment-specific interaction limits.

done_when.zh: 配置 diff 对照论文 Table 5 没有未解释差异。
done_when.en: A config diff against Table 5 has no unexplained differences.

title.zh: 同时复核分数与训练轨迹

body.zh: 先复现 Vanilla/GRPO，再运行 SEED；除了最终分数，还比较训练曲线、episode length、样本效率、unseen split 和消融结果。
body.en: Reproduce Vanilla/GRPO before SEED. Compare not only final scores but also training curves, episode length, sample efficiency, unseen splits, and ablations.

done_when.zh: 报告区分官方论文结果、你的独立运行结果和无法对齐的条件。
done_when.en: Your report separates paper-reported results, independent run results, and conditions that could not be aligned.

pitfalls.zh: 把训练期 hindsight skill 当成推理期 skill bank；SEED 部署时不需要分析器、检索模块或 skill prompt。
pitfalls.en: Treating training-time hindsight skills as an inference-time skill bank; SEED deploys without an analyzer, retrieval module, or skill prompt.

pitfalls.zh: Stage 2 继续使用静态外部 teacher；SEED 的关键是最新策略 checkpoint 同步承担 actor 与 analyzer。
pitfalls.en: Keeping a static external teacher in Stage 2; SEED's key is synchronizing actor and analyzer in the latest policy checkpoint.

pitfalls.zh: 缩小任务数、rollout 或 GPU 后仍与论文主表直接比较；这种运行只能证明代码链路或局部机制。
pitfalls.en: Comparing a reduced-task, reduced-rollout, or reduced-GPU run directly with the main tables; that run supports only code-path or local-mechanism validation.

pitfalls.zh: 只跑 SEED 不跑 GRPO；没有同环境同模型的基线，就无法归因 OPD 带来的变化。
pitfalls.en: Running SEED without GRPO; without a matched baseline, the effect of OPD cannot be attributed.

sources.title: SEED paper (arXiv HTML, v1)
sources.evidence_note: The paper defines the two-stage SEED method, identifies Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B backbones plus GLM-5.2 for offline skill annotation, reports ALFWorld/WebShop/Search settings, exact hyperparameters, and eight A800 80GB GPUs. The learning guide paraphrases these claims and labels reduced runs as method checks rather than strict reproductions.

sources.title: Official SEED code repository
sources.locator: README: Installation, Training, and Merge Checkpoints
sources.evidence_note: The official repository provides environment setup for ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, Stage 1 SFT scripts, Stage 2 veRL training entrypoints, and checkpoint merge instructions. It does not link a ready-to-download trained SEED checkpoint at the checked date, so checkpoint_url remains not_published.
